selected_dataset.public_summary: A binary classification dataset for demonstrating customer churn prediction in the first real Atlas DataFlow publication cycle.

non_fixture_confirmation.basis: Human operational decision by the project owner selected Telco Customer Churn as the first real publication dataset for M12-01.

downstream_usage.notes: M12-02 may use this decision as the source of dataset identity before assembling release candidate artifacts.

decision_rationale: The dataset is simple enough to validate the publisher release flow without introducing unnecessary product complexity.
The churn prediction use case is easy to explain in the public Atlas DataFlow experience.
The dataset replaces example-dataset as the first real publication target while preserving fixtures for tests and compatibility.
The dataset is suitable for demonstrating contract-first publication, registry activation, runtime inference, and publication evidence.

includes: Use Telco Customer Churn as the first real dataset release target.
Prepare the minimum release artifacts required by the Atlas DataFlow publisher.
Publish one real immutable release for this dataset.
Update the registry active release for this dataset after successful publication.
Record publication evidence for the release.
